text:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for canary -> staging: job `artifact-sign` (build 2026.03.20-rc2) timed out after 15m. Logs show 'signer connection error: handshake timeout'. Automatic promote aborted, manual review required.
jen: saw this, thanks. can we pin to the previous artifact to unblock the release? @maria @tom
maria: digging in logs now. signing-service returned 503s; s3 upload succeeded but registry index update failed, so checksum didn't land. looks transient but we can't promote without a signed artifact.
maria: logs snippet:
```
signer_service POST /sign -> 503 ServiceUnavailable
error: context deadline exceeded
artifact_id=sha256:abcd1234deadbeef...
```
tom: ok. pinning to previous artifact (sha256:1234prev) would keep the exact image digest — should be safe for canary, last canary passed smoke ~2h ago.
sre-oncall: seen similar earlier today. options: wait 30m for signer to recover; pin to last-green and proceed with canary; or hold and escalate to infra. I recommend pin to last-green + open infra ticket.
henry: +1 to pin and run the smoke/e2e checks after promote. also add a brief note in the release changelog that we used a pinned artifact due to signer outage. :thumbsup:
jen: ok i'm going to pin. @deploy-bot can you queue manual promote for 15:30 change window with artifact sha256:1234prev? i'll run the post-promote smoke tests.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Manual promote queued:
`deploybot promote --from canary --to staging --artifact sha256:1234prev --requested-by jen --window 2026-03-20T15:30Z`
maria: i'll open an incident with infra (signing-service 503) and assign @infra-oncall. linking logs and registry index failures.
tom: after promote, please run full smoke + perf quick checks. if any red flags, rollback plan: `deploybot rollback --to sha256:abcd1234deadbeef` (last-good).
jen: noted. i'll update the release-notes draft in the repo: add line "Pinned artifact to sha256:1234prev due to signing-service outage; will monitor and re-promote signed build when available."
sre-oncall: monitoring the promote and signer metrics. will post updates here. if signer doesn't recover within 60m, we escalate and consider backfill of signed manifest.
henry: thanks all. small ask: add a short postmortem checkbox in the release card so we remember to follow up.
jen: done. thanks everyone.
